name: にぎやかなカフェ
description: This is a cafe. A woman is sitting on a chair at the left table. A cup of coffee is on the left table. A man is sitting on a chair at the right table. A laptop is on the right table. Another man is standing between the two tables, talking on the phone. A woman is walking in front of the tables. A vending machine is in the back left corner.
